message: Cargo.toml's license may change once vg-paradigms answers the license.manifest mismatch (graft 01a10afb). (proposal 01a10afb-5a15-771d-9f1a-14e5bc311aa3, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

title: Match Cargo.toml's license to what vg-paradigms settles
body: Cargo.toml says GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Royalty-Free-1.0 OR LicenseRef-Commercial-1.0, as the license.manifest rule asks, while LICENSE.md and REUSE.toml grant GPL-3.0-only WITH AdditionRef-Open-Project-Exception-1.0. Re-render and re-check once the baseline settles one expression (or license-file), before publishing.
